name: 27th CEPR-JIE Conference on Applied Industrial Organization
organizer: CEPR and the Journal of Industrial Economics (JIE); hosted by Tilburg University
submission_requirements: Upload paper via CEPR HUB (log in or create a profile, go to event 5315, 'Step 1: Apply', tick 'Would you like to submit a paper?'); the submitting author is expected to attend the entire conference and present. Theoretical and empirical IO; dedicated session on Housing and Mortgages. Travel/accommodation funding not guaranteed (requests considered, priority to junior faculty)
membership_required: No membership requirement stated in the last call
